text_block_list.text: One day, El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder are training on their own.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You're just running recklessly… You need to pace yourself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ughhh… I know my trainer worked hard to come up with this training plan, but I just can't do it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I got it! What about that over there?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hang on, El…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Waaa-taaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Soaring into the ring with her fists of fury… the Condor Monk is hereee!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I was wondering where you went… Why did you change your clothes?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Silly Grass! You just don't get it.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But that's okay, I'll just explain—or better yet, I'll show you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Waaa-chaaa!
El Condor Pasa shouts and then dashes a lap around the track.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: How was that?! Behold, the spirit and stamina of the Condor Monk! I feel power coursin' through me!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Incredible… But, how?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to my outfit!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: When I wear the clothes of a powerful monk, I inherit that strength!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: For a warrior, an outfit is a kind of beacon guiding them to their goals. It's also a reminder to work hard and fulfill your dreams!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I think this is what my papa meant when he would tell me about his wrestling outfits!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see. I think I can understand that.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: When I put on a kimono, I feel at peace.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! Now you're gettin' it! Sometimes, you gotta dress for the part you want!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna wear all kinds of outfits and become the hella strong, hella unbeatable El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmmm. What should I wear next to get even stronger?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I know, right?! Now, what kind of outfit should I wear to get stronger?!
choice_data_list: A kimono could help you keep your calm.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I see! In that case…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I want Grass to teach me everything about kimonos!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: With pleasure. I'll choose something that suits you well. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Why not work on having a Japanese mindset as well? It might help you stay calm.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oooh! What should I do exactly?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: First, you should work on sitting properly. I think it'll help you relax and stay calm.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Y-you mean sitting on top of my legs?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But it makes my legs tingle… Well, if it'll make me stronger, then… Nnngh!
El Condor Pasa struggles with paying the price for strength.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! A martial arts uniform! Just like in the old movies!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The kind you'd wear when you thrust your fist into a waterfall!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's do it right now! I'll split that waterfall with this here fist!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I feel like those who train under waterfalls are usually on a spiritual journey, not a physical one… More importantly, where are you planning on finding a waterfall?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh! Good point! There aren't really any close by…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh well. Just wearing the outfit should be enough to feel differently, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That's true! Thank you, Grass! I almost lost sight of that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's do some training in a martial arts uniform next! Even if it's not quite as effective as training under a waterfall, I'm sure we'll see results!
A few days later, El Condor Pasa tells me how much fun she had training dressed up as a martial artist.
